subject: Staggered delegation arrivals — final rooming, keycard plan & dietary sync
messages:
From: Claire Ross <c.ross@acme-fin.com>

Subject: Final delegation list — staggered arrivals & dietary notes

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for coordinating the Redwood regional workshop next week. We're finalizing the travel side from our end — attaching the delegation roster (acme_delegation_final.csv). A few quick notes: 

- Delegation of 12, split across three arrival windows (Fri 9/24 morning, Fri 9/24 afternoon, Sat 9/25 early AM).
- One attendee (S. Patel) requires a ground-floor or elevator-accessible room due to mobility restrictions.
- Two attendees are strictly vegetarian; one has a nut allergy (please ensure separate prep).
- We can consolidate any pickups if you prefer fewer shuttle runs.

Can you confirm: rooming master, keycard pickup process for staggered check-ins, and whether the hotel can waive early check-in fees for the morning group? Also loop in your hotel contact so we can get a single manifest.

Appreciate it — Claire

Hi Claire — thanks for the roster.

Quick plan from our ops side:

- I'll maintain the rooming master and send the official hotel manifest by Thursday EOD. (Attached: redwood_rooming_master.xlsx)
- Laura: can you confirm the VIP suite allocation for the Acme CTO (requested two-night block Fri-Sun)? We noted one suite was put on hold; want to make that final.
- Stephanie: please confirm with Hilton whether they can waive early check-in fees for the 9/24 morning arrivals and whether we can stage keycard pickup in the lobby for each arrival window.
- I'll coordinate shuttle windows and share a consolidated pickup schedule; fewer runs is fine if it works for everyone.

On dietary: we'll provide a separate sheet to the catering lead with vegetarian and allergy flags — Stephanie, I'll need your final list for the caterer by Friday 9/18 noon.

Hotel contact — Laura Romero at Hilton North Bay is cc'd on the next reply from our side. If Hilton needs the full manifest earlier, tell us and we'll move it up.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — quick confirmation and one special request: 

- VIP suite: confirm hold converted to reservation for Acme CTO Sat 9/25 14:00 checkout (2-night block confirmed).
- Mobility accommodation: S. Patel needs ground-floor or elevator-adjacent room — I've flagged this on the attached rooming master row.
- Shuttle consolidation: prefer two runs (morning and afternoon) to minimize waiting; we'll publish exact times once Stephanie confirms with hotel pickup window.

Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:01:56 -0700
Subject: Re: Final delegation list — staggered arrivals & dietary notes

Good morning Marissa and Claire,

Thanks for the manifest — we've reviewed the incoming delegation and can accommodate the staggered check-ins. A few items from the hotel side: 

- Early check-in fees: Hilton North Bay will waive early check-in fees for up to 6 rooms on 9/24. For any additional morning arrivals, a nominal fee applies unless rooms are available the night before.
- Keycard pickup: We can set up an express keycard station in the main lobby between 7:30–9:30 for the morning group, and 13:00–15:00 for the afternoon group. We'll staff it and have a named contact (Jason H., lead concierge).
- Accessibility: S. Patel is assigned room 102 (ground-floor, elevator adjacent).
- Catering/dietary: We'll pass your dietary file to our executive chef and mark vegetarian/nut-allergy meals separately with sealed preparation.

Attached: hilton_block_manifest.pdf (PDF, 45 KB) — this reflects the block numbers and the temporary holds we converted.

If you want, we can also pre-provision keycards for the entire group and leave them with your on-site host to hand out; otherwise we'll do express pickup as above. Please advise.

Best,
Laura Romero
Senior Sales Manager — Hilton North Bay

Attachment: hilton_block_manifest.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Final delegation list — staggered arrivals & dietary notes

Thank you all — final confirmations below.

1) Keycards & check-in approach
- Hilton to run express keycard pickup windows: 7:30–9:30 (morning), 13:00–15:00 (afternoon).
- We will NOT pre-provision keycards. On-site Redwood host (Laura Bennett) will monitor the desk and collect any late arrivals.

2) Rooms & accessibility
- VIP suite reserved for Acme CTO (sat-sun).
- S. Patel assigned room 102 (ground-floor).

3) Early check-in fees
- Accepted waiver for up to 6 early rooms. Marissa will re-route any overflow to the 2nd-run shuttle or request a last-minute room release.

4) Dietary & catering
- Stephanie: final dietary file due by 9/18 12:00. We will send to Hilton executive chef and caterer.

5) Shuttle plan and staging
- Two shuttle runs from the airport on 9/24 (08:45 and 13:30). Return shuttle 9/26 17:30 and 20:00. Detailed passenger assignments will be shared by EOD Monday.

6) Docs and next steps
- I've uploaded the final rooming master and manifest to our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-redwood-workshop-2026
- If anyone needs to authorize late-night arrivals, please sign the check-in guarantee here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/REDWOOD-CHKIN-2026

Thanks — this looks good to go from Redwood. See you onsite.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
